summary.result: To examine whether relatively warm and humid air actually flowed into the Korean Peninsula recently, temperatures and specific humidity in all layers in the troposphere were analyzed and according to the results the Korean Peninsula showed warm and humid anomalies.
summary.background: In the present study, the time series of the number of days on which temperatures were not higher than -5℃ in winter in Seoul was analyzed.
summary.method: In all layers of the troposphere, anomalous anticyclones developed in regions around the Korean Peninsula and thus the Korean Peninsula was affected by westerlies or south-westerlies.
